library(haven)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
library(labelled)
library(readr)

# Define paths and filenames
input_path <- "data/input/"
output_path <- "data/output/"

# Load metadata files into separate objects
wave1 <- read_delim(paste0(input_path, "wave_one_lsype_young_person_2020.tab"), delim = "\t")
wave2 <- read_delim(paste0(input_path, "wave_two_lsype_young_person_2020.tab"), delim = "\t")
wave3 <- read_delim(paste0(input_path, "wave_three_lsype_family_background_2020.tab"), delim = "\t")
wave4 <- read_delim(paste0(input_path, "wave_four_lsype_family_background_2020.tab"), delim = "\t")

# Merge all datasets using full_join by NSID
merged_data <- wave1 %>%
  full_join(wave2, by = "NSID") %>%
  full_join(wave3, by = "NSID") %>%
  full_join(wave4, by = "NSID")

# Define the mapping for missing values
missing_value_mapping <- list(
  # Source -94 maps to -2
  "-94" = -2,
  # Source -1 maps to -8
  "-1" = -8,
  # Other missing codes to standard codes
  "-999" = -3,
  "-998" = -2,
  "-997" = -2,
  "-995" = -2,
  "-99" = -3,
  "-92" = -9,
  "-91" = -1
)

# Define the priority order for deriving lang variable
priority_order <- c("W1englangYP", "W2EnglangYP", "W3englangHH", "W4EngLangHH")

# Create a function to map missing values
map_missing_values <- function(x) {
  if (is.numeric(x)) {
    if (x %in% as.numeric(names(missing_value_mapping))) {
      return(as.numeric(missing_value_mapping[as.character(x)]))
    } else if (is.na(x)) {
      return(-3)
    } else {
      return(x)
    }
  } else {
    return(x)
  }
}

# Derive the lang variable using the priority order
merged_data <- merged_data %>%
  mutate(
    lang = case_when(
      !is.na(W1englangYP) ~ map_missing_values(W1englangYP),
      !is.na(W2EnglangYP) ~ map_missing_values(W2EnglangYP),
      !is.na(W3englangHH) ~ map_missing_values(W3englangHH),
      !is.na(W4EngLangHH) ~ map_missing_values(W4EngLangHH),
      TRUE ~ -3
    )
  )

# Remove source variables to keep only the derived lang variable and NSID
final_data <- merged_data %>%
  select(NSID, lang)

# Ensure lang is a labeled factor with appropriate labels

  "1" = "English only",
  "2" = "English first/main and speaks other languages",
  "3" = "Another language is first/main",
  "4" = "Bilingual",
  "-9" = "Refusal",
  "-8" = "Don't know",
  "-7" = "Prefer not to say",
  "-3" = "Not asked/Not interviewed",
  "-2" = "Schedule not applicable/Script error",
  "-1" = "Item not applicable"
)
